accepted_at.description: Trusted-local service acceptance time bound into the entry digest. Ledger order uses ingestion_sequence, not this field alone.

occurred_at.description: Caller-asserted event time (RFC 3339 UTC, millisecond precision). Not service acceptance time.

occurred_at_consistency.description: Exact comparison of caller-asserted occurred_at with service accepted_at. Caller time through five seconds ahead is within_forward_skew_allowance; larger forward drift is ahead_of_forward_skew_allowance. This does not verify caller time or affect ingestion-sequence ordering.
